plan.notes: TERM-BY-TERM SEQUENCE: official Cal Poly 2026-2028 semester catalog "Plan of Study Grid" ("Sociology"). Flowcharts are the university's suggested sequence; the catalog notes courses may be completed in a different order provided requisite requirements are satisfied. Credit ranges in the source use the LOWER bound (e.g. Technical Elective 3-4 -> 3). "X or Y" rows use the first-listed option as the plan code with alternatives in options. Prereqs not transcribed: the grid does not state them explicitly.
